News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 19, 2026 09:37 AM November 19, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 09:37 AM November 19, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court resumes Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, with the defense set to present four government officials as witnesses.
On Day 44, the proceedings will test whether the defense can address the prosecution’s allegations of P817.17 million in unexplained wealth, questionable business transactions involving a company linked to her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, and Duterte’s financial disclosures.
